raw: I remember a new classmate eating lunch alone. There was just one tray on his table, and that was what caught my attention. A single tray isn’t much to notice, really, but it made me think about being new somewhere and not having anyone to sit with. I didn’t know whether he actually wanted company, but I felt for him. I had a group to eat with, and he didn’t seem to have that yet, so I invited him to join us. I wanted him to know there was a place for him if he wanted it.
